operations.details: Verified official OGC GeoSciML standard page.
Geological model separated from bare-earth surface measurement.
Borehole/geoscience exchange not promoted to parcel terrain height.
GeoSciML domain semantics rejected as LiDAR vertical-accuracy evidence.
Verified official OGC LAS specification page.
LAS transport format separated from point classification quality.
Point-cloud presence does not prove bare-earth DTM classification.
LAS records require independent datum, epoch and vertical-accuracy validation.
GeoSciML and LAS URLs confirmed absent from prior source registry.
No geology or generic point-cloud value substituted for parcel result.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
